environment.description: Lambda function deployed with function URL auth_type=AWS_IAM. Origin access is configured through a CloudFront distribution (ID: E2X8ABC123DEF) with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy sigv4 signing for lambda function URL origin. The distribution has a custom cache policy (CachingDisabled, ID: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad) and origin request policy that forwards query strings. CloudFront key group (KG-9F2A3B) is associated with the default cache behavior requiring signed URLs (trusted key group with RSA-2048 public key). Viewers must present a valid CloudFront signed URL with policy statement constraining the resource pattern to /oauth/authorize* path only. The distribution's WAF WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:global/webacl/oauth-protect/a1b2c3d4) includes a custom rule with regex pattern set matching redirect_uri parameter values - however this rule is in COUNT mode only for monitoring. The Lambda resource policy restricts invoke permission exclusively to the CloudFront service principal (cloudfront.amazonaws.com) with condition on the specific distribution ARN.

config.lambda_resource_policy: Allow invoke only from cloudfront.amazonaws.com with StringEquals aws:SourceArn condition for distribution E2X8ABC123DEF
config.cloudfront_distribution: E2X8ABC123DEF with OAC sigv4 signing to Lambda function URL origin
config.cloudfront_signed_urls: Required via trusted key group KG-9F2A3B, RSA-2048, policy restricts resource to https://d1abc2def3.cloudfront.net/oauth/authorize*
config.cloudfront_oac: Origin Access Control with sigv4 signing, Lambda function URL origin
config.waf_webacl: Custom rule on redirect_uri regex in COUNT mode (not blocking)
config.cache_behavior: CachingDisabled policy, query strings forwarded to origin
